meta.title: Weiming HPC
meta.description: Logs in to the Peking University Weiming cluster (wm1-data, wm1-login, wm2-data, wm2-login) over SSH with a password and a TOTP code, and exposes the wm_server_status, wm_server_setup, and wm_server_run tools. Every call checks ~/.config/wm2/credentials.json first; when credentials are missing it returns the acquisition steps instead of attempting a login: open the HPC one-time-password binding page, scan the QR code with WeChat, copy the resulting text (otpauth://...), then pass that text, the account password and the account (required, no built-in default) to wm_server_setup. Secrets are written to that file with mode 600 and are never echoed; tools return only a key fingerprint. Before a remote command runs, the bundle probes the target port and, when the machine is outside the campus network and not on the school VPN, asks the user to connect first instead of attempting authentication. Works on macOS and Linux; on Windows it requires the MSYS2 OpenSSH shipped with Git for Windows (the inbox Win32-OpenSSH is not supported). Each credential is submitted at most once per connection, and the plugin does not transfer files.
